quote.text: When honesty is lost, then wait for the Hour.

shots.framing: HOOK. Wide: an endless column of followers pouring across a highway overpass into a city at dawn
shots.vo_markup: In thirty days, his followers took eleven *cities.*
shots.vo: In thirty days, his followers took eleven cities.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The column of people with plain banners (no symbols) flowing into the city
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0. People on twos, dust/sun on ones. Column reaches the city gate on "cities".

shots.framing: Close: open empty hands raised in a crowd, some holding bread and flowers
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Raised open hands, bread, flowers; no weapons anywhere

shots.framing: High wide: a city square flooding with people from every street
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: People streaming in from all sides until the square is full

shots.framing: Three hard cuts inside the shot: three different invented city skylines, the same plain banner rising on a tower in each
shots.vo_markup: In every city, the same thing happened.
shots.vo: In every city, the same thing happened.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Each cut about a third of the shot. Invented cities only.

shots.framing: Medium: a doctor in a white coat escorted out of hospital doors by followers
shots.vo_markup: The people who knew how things worked were pushed *aside…*
shots.vo: The people who knew how things worked were pushed aside…
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The doctor looking back at the hospital as he is led away
shots.notes: Push on "aside". No violence: a firm hand on the shoulder.

shots.framing: Low angle: a man shouting through a megaphone on the hospital steps; crowd cheering below
shots.vo_markup: and the loudest voices took their *place.*
shots.vo: and the loudest voices took their place.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The megaphone man, mouth wide, fist up

shots.framing: Medium: a hospital corridor, the loud man in a too-big white coat, nurses staring at each other
shots.vo_markup: A man with no training ran the *hospital.*
shots.vo: A man with no training ran the hospital.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The ill-fitting coat, the confused nurses
shots.notes: He grabs a chart upside down on "hospital".

shots.framing: Medium: a classroom; a man erases a chalkboard full of maths and writes "HE KNOWS" in crooked letters; children watch
shots.vo_markup: A man who could barely read rewrote the *schools.*
shots.vo: A man who could barely read rewrote the schools.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Last letter on "schools". Text exactly: HE KNOWS.

shots.framing: Wide: followers clumsily building a bridge over a river, crooked beams, ropes, cheering
shots.vo_markup: A new bridge was built by people who had never built *anything.*
shots.vo: A new bridge was built by people who had never built anything.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Crooked steel and planks; a beam swinging
shots.notes: A beam clangs into place crooked on "anything".

shots.framing: Wide: ribbon cutting on the new bridge, confetti, crowds packed on it
shots.vo_markup: On the day it opened, the crowds *cheered.*
shots.vo: On the day it opened, the crowds cheered.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide night: the empty bridge buckling and collapsing into the dark river, spray and dust
shots.vo: On the third night, it fell.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Span drops on "fell". Empty bridge: NO people, NO vehicles.

shots.framing: Medium: the broken end of the bridge over black water, a single streetlight flickering at the edge
shots.vo_markup: No one was on it. Not yet.
shots.vo: No one was on it. Not yet.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The flickering lamp at the broken edge

shots.framing: Medium: an engineer with rolled blueprints, a follower's hand on his shoulder steering him into a van; the blueprints fall into a puddle
shots.vo_markup: The engineers who warned them had already been *silenced.*
shots.vo: The engineers who warned them had already been silenced.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The blueprints splashing into the puddle

shots.framing: Wide: an abandoned council office, dust in a light beam, an empty chair behind a long desk
shots.vo_markup: A man once asked the Prophet when the Hour would come. He said: when trust is lost. And when authority is handed to those unfit for it.
shots.vo: A man once asked the Prophet when the Hour would come. He said: when trust is lost. And when authority is handed to those unfit for it.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The empty chair in the beam of light
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay (top ~15–40%): keep the upper area dark and calm.

shots.framing: Medium: a bus terminal; doctors, teachers, engineers with suitcases boarding a bus; a child waving
shots.vo_markup: Across the country, the experts packed their *bags.*
shots.vo: Across the country, the experts packed their bags.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Suitcases, a white coat folded over an arm

shots.framing: Low angle: the megaphone man on a car roof waving, crowds around him
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The megaphone silhouette against the sky

shots.framing: Close: a heavy chain wrapped around library gates; a padlock snaps shut; follower silhouettes behind
shots.vo_markup: And in the capital, the man from nowhere gave his next order: close the *libraries.*
shots.vo: And in the capital, the man from nowhere gave his next order: close the libraries.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The chain and padlock; the library facade behind
shots.notes: Padlock clicks on "libraries". The man from nowhere is NOT shown.

shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Same title design as previous chapters.
